directPaymentDiscovery.scope: Official Freisinger Stadtwerke location-level public charging page, tariff status 2025-05-01 and still current on the operator site
directPaymentDiscovery.note: The operator page enumerates the public locations and repeats the applicable class tariff at station level. Third-party roaming prices are explicitly excluded.

reason: The current official operator surface publishes exact own-network public tariffs and maps them to each listed station class; several station descriptions explicitly state that no personal-data registration is required, so no roaming or station extrapolation is needed.
